title: Usage record (usage-records/1)
description: One line of a usage drop: one model request (or one attempt and model) with no conversation. Records are unique by (the drop's namespace, id); a record sent again replaces the stored one.

id.description: Stable across copies of the source, such as a labeling attempt ID.

route.description: How the request was made, such as claude, codex or agy.

served_model.description: The model that answered, when it differs.

machine.description: key of a machine declared in the result, when the requests ran elsewhere. Omitted means this Mac.

cost.description: Spend. usd counts as cost only when status is priced or assumed; other statuses are unpriced usage.

priced_model.description: The price-book model used, when it differs from model.

outcome.description: ok, failed, invalid and so on. Failed requests with usage still count.

automation.description: Marks the usage as automation in the usage views. kind becomes the channel (for example Automated: labeling); the other labels become fields.
